_doc: Legendary powers (ruling 18: the loot chase, no sockets). A LEGENDARY ITEM = a random base rolled like a rare (3-5 affixes, affixes.json) plus ONE power from this list whose `kinds` includes the item's kind (weapons by kind id, armour by slot, "ring"/"neck"/"shield"/"focus"/"quiver"/"belt") and whose ilvlMin <= ilvl. The power shows as an orange line on the tooltip and the item name is "<power name> <base>" (e.g. "Oxhide Grip Hide Gloves"). Each `rule` is an object a programmer implements in js/rules/effects.js: `type` is the hook, the rest are its numbers. Every power changes HOW a skill works or a playstyle, never just a number. A power for a Path a player has not chosen still drops (trade bait, 20% off-Path per rarity.json basePick) but is down-weighted 0.25 by the personal-loot smart roll. SKILL IDS: these name Path skills M9 will build (fighter_cleave, fighter_shield_slam, fighter_war_cry, fighter_charge, fighter_rend; rogue_slip_step, rogue_backstab, rogue_aimed_shot, rogue_poison_coat, rogue_knife_fan; mage_firebolt, mage_frost_ring, mage_storm_lance, mage_shift, mage_ward; healer_mend, healer_radiance, healer_smite, healer_rebuke, healer_sanctify). If M9 names a skill differently, change the id HERE; nothing else couples to it. A power whose skill the player does not have does nothing (the tooltip says so in grey). Spec skills replace Path skills (ruling 10), so each power also lists `specAlso`: the spec skills that inherit it (fill in as specs land; empty = Path skill only).

powers.name: Oxhide Grip
